interfaces.name: ItemIdentifier
interfaces.doc: Identifies a highlighted / clicked / focused item.

interfaces.name: BaseSeriesOptions
interfaces.doc: Properties shared by all series. Data can be provided in three ways: 1. `data` as an array of values aligned with the category axis `data` 2. `dataKey` reading a field from the chart `dataset` 3. long-format rows (`data` rows or chart-level `data`) with `dimension` / `metric` fields, optionally split into several series by `groupBy` (one series per distinct value, in order of first appearance)

props.name: color
props.doc: Static color (CSS color or theme token).

props.name: colorField
props.doc: Field holding a per-row CSS color (bypasses the palette).

props.name: colors
props.doc: Explicit palette for the groups produced by `groupBy`.

props.name: excludeFromInteraction
props.doc: Rows / items excluded from interaction (tooltip, highlight).

props.name: excludeDataKeys
props.doc: Rows where any of these fields is truthy get no tooltip and no hover highlight.

props.name: disableTooltip
props.doc: Hovering this series shows no tooltip (other series still do).

props.name: cursor
props.doc: CSS cursor while an item of this series is under the pointer (e.g. 'pointer' for clickable marks).

props.name: stack
props.doc: Series sharing a stack id are stacked.

props.name: layout
props.doc: 'horizontal' draws bars along the x axis.

props.name: roundCorners
props.doc: Round only the outer end of a bar (default) or every corner.

props.name: barLabel
props.type: 'value' | ((item: { value: number | null; dataIndex: number; seriesId: string; datum?: Datum }) => string | null)

props.name: barLabelPlacement
props.doc: 'start' sits inside the bar near its base; 'outside' past its end.

props.name: barLabelBadge
props.doc: Draws labels on a filled badge (bar annotations).

props.name: barLabelOverflow
props.doc: Labels that do not fit: hide them (default) or let them spill past the bar.

props.name: barLabelFormat
props.doc: Number format for `barLabel: 'value'`.

props.name: area
props.doc: Fill below the line. `true` uses the line color at 30% opacity.

props.name: gradient
props.doc: Gradient area fill fading to transparent.

props.name: showMark
props.type: boolean | 'start' | 'end' | ((p: { index: number; value: number | null; datum?: Datum }) => boolean)

props.name: alternateField
props.doc: Field with a truthy value for points drawn with the alternate dash (e.g. forecasts).

props.name: sampling
props.doc: Downsampling for dense series ('auto' = min-max above 2 points per pixel).

props.name: metricRanges
props.doc: Bands between two fields drawn around the line (confidence intervals, targets).

props.name: lineTypeField
props.doc: Field whose distinct values select a dash pattern from `lineTypes` (one per group).

props.name: displayOnHover
props.doc: Only show the range while its series is highlighted.

props.name: scaleAxisToFit
props.doc: Widen the value axis so the whole range is visible. Default true.

props.name: lineWidth
props.doc: Width of the range boundary lines in px. Default 1.

props.name: lineOpacity
props.doc: Opacity of the range boundary lines. Default 1.

props.name: metricStart
props.doc: Floating band between two metrics (disables stacking).

props.name: sizeField
props.doc: Field used for the bubble size (or `size` on point objects).

props.name: sizeRange
props.doc: [min, max] pixel diameter when sized by a field.

props.name: colorValueField
props.doc: Continuous color by a numeric field using `colorScheme`.

props.name: positions
props.doc: Typed array fast path: interleaved [x0, y0, x1, y1, …]. Skips per-item transitions.

props.name: innerRadius
props.doc: Px or percentage of the available radius, e.g. '60%'.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Degrees.

props.name: paddingAngle
props.doc: Degrees between slices.

props.name: arcLabelSecondary
props.doc: A second line under the arc label (e.g. the value or percent under the category).

props.name: arcLabelField
props.doc: Datum field used for `arcLabel: 'label'`.

props.name: arcLabelPosition
props.doc: Labels inside the ring (default) or outside it.

props.name: percentFormat
props.doc: Number format for percent labels. Default '.0%'.

props.name: centerLabel
props.doc: Content drawn in the center of a donut.

props.name: data
props.doc: Categories / values for ordinal axes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Axis title. An array draws one line per entry.

props.name: tickNumber
props.doc: Target tick count (continuous axes).

props.name: maxTicks
props.doc: Upper limit on the tick count (continuous axes). As in the legacy library the first (base) tick is not counted: `0, 1, 2, 3` is three ticks.

props.name: minTicks
props.doc: Lower limit on the tick count (continuous axes), counted like `maxTicks`.

props.name: tickMinStep
props.doc: Minimum step between ticks in domain units (numeric, non-log axes).

props.name: tickValues
props.doc: Explicit tick values.

props.name: labels
props.type: ReadonlyArray< DomainValue | { value: DomainValue; label?: string; align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'; fontWeight?: 'normal' | 'bold' | number } >
props.doc: Explicit ticks: only these are drawn. An object can set the label text, its alignment and its font weight. Overrides `tickValues`.

props.name: subLabels
props.type: ReadonlyArray<{ value: DomainValue; subLabel: string; align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'; fontWeight?: 'normal' | 'bold' | number }>
props.doc: A second label line under the tick labels with matching values.

props.name: labelAlign
props.doc: Alignment of every tick label within its band (or around its tick). Default 'center'.

props.name: labelFontWeight
props.doc: Font weight of every tick label. Default 'normal'.

props.name: currencyCode
props.doc: ISO 4217 code used by the `currency` / `shortCurrency` number formats (e.g. 'EUR').

props.name: currencyLocale
props.doc: BCP 47 locale for the currency symbol's placement (e.g. 'de-DE').

props.name: tickLabelAngle
props.doc: Tick label rotation in degrees (x and y axes); -90 draws vertical labels.

props.name: baseline
props.doc: Draws a highlighted 0 line.

props.name: granularity
props.doc: Time axes: the label format and the tick interval (one tick per day, week, month, ...).

props.name: categoryOuterGapRatio
props.doc: Band axes: outer padding as a fraction of the step. Default half of `categoryGapRatio`.

props.name: labelLimit
props.doc: Max label width in px before truncation with an ellipsis (ordinal axes). `'band'` truncates to the band step.

props.name: zoom
props.type: boolean | { minSpan?: number; maxSpan?: number; slider?: boolean }
props.doc: Enables wheel / drag zoom on this axis (continuous axes).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Grouped (multi-level) category labels. Each level maps a category to its group; consecutive categories with the same group share one bracketed label. Levels are drawn outward from the axis (ordinal axes only).

props.name: thumbnails
props.doc: Images drawn next to each tick (e.g. logos, avatars, flags).

props.name: annotations
props.doc: Event markers and spans drawn in a lane alongside the axis.

props.name: annotationFormat
props.doc: `span` draws every annotation; `summary` collapses them into one badge.

props.name: getValue
props.type: (value: DomainValue, index: number) => string | number | null | undefined
props.doc: Group key for a category.

props.name: format
props.doc: Optional label formatter for the group key.

props.name: url
props.doc: Image URL for a tick value (undefined draws nothing).

props.name: size
props.doc: Box size in px. Default 24.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius in px (use size / 2 for circles). Default 4.

props.name: hideLabel
props.doc: Hides the text label and shows only the image.

props.name: value
props.doc: Single position (draws a marker).

props.name: start
props.doc: Span start / end (draws a bar).

props.name: description
props.doc: Longer text shown in the tooltip.

interfaces.name: PointAnnotationOptions
interfaces.doc: A labelled callout attached to a data point.

props.name: x
props.doc: x value (category, number or date).

props.name: y
props.doc: y value; when omitted it is read from `seriesId` at `x`.

props.name: markIndex
props.doc: Restricts the `seriesId` lookup to series of this entry of `ChartOptions.series`.

props.name: matchLineColor
props.doc: Badge in the series color (default) or plain text in the theme text color.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Side of the point the label sits on. Default 'top'.

props.name: offset
props.doc: Leader line length in px. Default 26.

props.name: marker
props.doc: Draws a ring around the point. Default true.

interfaces.name: ScatterPathOptions
interfaces.doc: Lines connecting scatter points (trajectories, before/after pairs).

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Datum field(s) that split points into separate paths.

props.name: order
props.doc: Order points by x or keep data order. Default 'data'.

interfaces.name: ScatterLabelOptions
interfaces.doc: Text labels next to scatter points, skipping labels that would overlap.

props.name: field
props.doc: Datum field to show; defaults to the point's y value.

props.name: position
props.doc: Side of the point; a list is tried in order until a label fits.

props.name: indices
props.doc: Only label these data indices.

props.name: toggleable
props.doc: Click toggles series visibility.

props.name: clickable
props.doc: Entries are buttons that report clicks (`onLegendClick`) even when not toggleable.

props.name: labelLimit
props.doc: Max label width in px (ellipsis beyond; the full text stays in the title attribute).

props.name: titleLimit
props.doc: Max title width in px.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Hover highlights the series.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Overrides displayed labels by series id.

props.name: hiddenEntries
props.doc: Series ids not shown in the legend.

props.name: markIndex
props.doc: Index of the series options (`ChartOptions.series`) that produced this item.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Anchor at the cursor or at the mark.

props.name: customContent
props.doc: When true the engine positions the container but leaves content to the host (e.g. React portal).

props.name: render
props.doc: Plain DOM rendering hook.

props.name: filter
props.doc: Return false to show no tooltip for this context (also applies with `customContent`).

props.name: x1
props.doc: Data-space corners; omit a bound to extend to the plot edge.

props.name: seriesId
props.doc: Series the trendline is computed from (default: every visible cartesian series).

props.name: markIndex
props.doc: Only series produced by this entry of `ChartOptions.series`.

props.name: displayOnHover
props.doc: Only drawn while its series is highlighted.

props.name: excludeDataKeys
props.doc: Rows where any of these fields is truthy are left out of the fit.

props.name: hidePartialWindows
props.doc: Moving averages: skip the first points that have no full window (default true).

props.name: labelBadge
props.doc: Draws the label on a filled badge.

props.name: extend
props.doc: Extend the line to the full x domain (regressions only).

props.name: label
props.doc: Label drawn at the end of the line; receives the last trend value.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.doc: 'axis' draws the label outside the plot, next to the axis.

props.name: bandPosition
props.doc: On band axes: at the start, center (default) or end of the band.

props.name: enter
props.doc: Initial draw-in animation.

props.name: data
props.doc: Long-format rows shared by series that use `dimension` / `metric`.

props.name: dataset
props.doc: Wide-format rows used by `dataKey`.

props.name: trendlines
props.doc: Regression / smoothing lines over series (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: pointAnnotations
props.doc: Labelled callouts on data points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: scatterPaths
props.doc: Paths connecting scatter points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: scatterLabels
props.doc: Labels next to scatter points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: marquee
props.doc: Drag to select. Default action zooms into the selection (double-click, Esc or the reset chip go back); `{ action: 'select' }` keeps it and reports the covered items. Loaded on demand.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Adds the toolbar plugin (zoom, downloads, print, full screen) when using hosts that read it.

props.name: initialZoom
props.doc: Initial zoom windows (requires the zoom plugin).

props.name: description
props.doc: Accessible description; auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.doc: Controlled hidden series ids.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.doc: Initial hidden series ids (uncontrolled).

props.name: highlightedItem
props.doc: Controlled highlight. `null` clears; `undefined` leaves it uncontrolled.

props.name: highlightedId
props.doc: Controlled highlight by row id (the `idKey` field); used when `highlightedItem` is unset.

props.name: idKey
props.doc: Row field that identifies a datum (item keys, `highlightedId`). Default `id`, then `key`.

props.name: directLabels
props.doc: Labels next to the end (or start) of each line / area series (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: onItemClick
props.type: (item: ItemIdentifier & { datum?: Datum; value?: number | null; markIndex?: number }, event: PointerEvent) => void

props.name: onItemContextMenu
props.type: (item: ItemIdentifier & { datum?: Datum; markIndex?: number }, event: MouseEvent) => void

props.name: onItemHover
props.type: (item: (ItemIdentifier & { datum?: Datum; markIndex?: number }) | null) => void
props.doc: Pointer enters (item) or leaves (null) a mark.

props.name: onLegendHover
props.doc: Pointer enters (id) or leaves (null) a legend entry.

props.name: onAxisLabelClick
props.type: (axisId: string, value: string | number, index: number) => void
props.doc: A tick label was clicked.

props.name: axisLabelTooltips
props.doc: Axis ids (or all axes) whose labels show their full text on hover.

props.name: onAxisClick
props.type: (data: { axisValue: DomainValue; dataIndex: number }, event: PointerEvent) => void

props.name: xField
props.doc: Field names (rows) — tuples `[x, y, value]` are accepted too.

props.name: colorScheme
props.doc: Sequential / diverging scheme name (e.g. 'viridis', 'redBlue').

props.name: thresholds
props.doc: Piecewise color map: values below each threshold get its color.

props.name: colorDomain
props.doc: Domain for the continuous color map (defaults to the data extent).

props.name: bodyWidth
props.doc: Body width as a fraction of the band.

props.name: style
props.doc: 'candle' (filled bodies) or 'ohlc' (bars with open / close ticks).

props.name: volume
props.doc: Field with traded volume; drawn as bars along the bottom of the plot.

props.name: volumeHeight
props.doc: Fraction of the plot height used by volume bars. Default 0.2.

props.name: lastPrice
props.type: boolean | { color?: ColorInput; format?: (v: number) => string }
props.doc: Dashed line at the last close with a price badge on the right edge.

props.name: layout
props.doc: 'horizontal' gives Gantt-style timelines.

props.name: progressField
props.doc: Optional progress field (0..1) drawn as an inner bar (Gantt).

props.name: totalField
props.doc: Rows whose field is truthy are drawn as totals (from zero).

props.name: whiskers
props.doc: 'iqr' uses 1.5×IQR whiskers with outliers; 'minmax' spans all values.

props.name: variant
props.doc: 'funnel' narrows to the last value, 'pyramid' is triangular.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Gap between sections (px).

props.name: sectionLabel
props.doc: Label inside each section: value, percent of first, or label.

props.name: depth
props.doc: Depth of nodes that are drawn (1 = top level children).

props.name: nodes
props.type: { id: string; label?: string; color?: ColorInput }[]

props.name: data
props.doc: Rows (with `setsField` / `metric` / `labelField`) instead of `sets`.

props.name: setsField
props.doc: Row field holding the sets array. Default 'sets'.

props.name: labelField
props.doc: Row field holding each region's label. Default 'label'.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Degrees clockwise of the second circle from the first, or the legacy '0deg' … '270deg'.

props.name: data
props.doc: Rows: { label, value, target, max?, thresholds? }.

props.name: thresholds
props.type: ({ value: number; color: ColorInput } | { thresholdMin?: number; thresholdMax?: number; fill?: ColorInput })[]
props.doc: `{ value, color }` (upper bound) or the legacy `{ thresholdMin?, thresholdMax?, fill }`.

props.name: scaleType
props.doc: Shared scale: 'normal' fits the data, 'fixed' uses `maxScaleValue`, 'flexible' grows past it. Unset: each row on its own.

props.name: thresholdBarColor
props.doc: Colors the bar with the threshold band its value falls in.

props.name: metrics
props.doc: Metric names (axes) in order; values read from rows by name.

props.name: max
props.doc: Max per metric (defaults to the max across series).

props.name: matrix
props.doc: Square matrix of flows; matrix[i][j] = flow from i to j.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Degrees.

props.name: geoJson
props.doc: GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

props.name: idProperty
props.doc: Property used as region id.

props.name: rotate
props.doc: Orthographic rotation [lambda, phi] in degrees.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Shape every item takes; changing it morphs items on the GPU.

props.name: span
props.doc: Visible span in axis units (ms for time axes); null resets.

props.name: slider
props.doc: Zoom slider with a data preview below the plot.

props.name: wheel
props.doc: Wheel / trackpad-pinch zoom. Default true.

props.name: pan
props.doc: Drag to pan. Default true (Shift+drag when a marquee owns plain drags).

props.name: keyboard
props.doc: +/- / 0 and Shift+arrows. Default true.

props.name: rangeButtons
props.doc: Preset spans shown as buttons in the top-right corner.

props.name: minSpan
props.doc: Smallest visible span, in axis units.

props.name: x
props.doc: Selected x range (numbers for continuous axes, categories for ordinal axes).

props.name: y
props.doc: Selected y range ('y' and 'xy' modes, or a category range on ordinal y axes).

props.name: items
props.type: { seriesId: string; dataIndex: number; datum?: Datum; x?: DomainValue; y?: number | null }[]
props.doc: Items inside the selection.

interfaces.name: MarqueeState
interfaces.doc: Live marquee state: pixel positions (plot coordinates) and the selection they cover.

props.name: active
props.doc: True while dragging; false for a selection kept after release.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Default true when options are given.

props.name: action
props.doc: What a finished drag does: zoom into it (default), keep it as a selection, or nothing.

props.name: mode
props.doc: 'x' selects a horizontal range, 'y' a vertical one, 'xy' a rectangle. Default: 'xy' for scatter, 'y' for horizontal bars, else 'x'.

props.name: modifier
props.doc: Require Shift while dragging. Default 'none' (Shift+drag then pans a zoomed chart).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep the selection after release ('select' action). Default true.

props.name: overlay
props.doc: Draw the selection rectangle. Default true.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Value badges at the selection edges. Default true.

props.name: preventTooltip
props.doc: Hide tooltips while dragging. Default true.

props.name: preventHighlight
props.doc: Clear hover highlight while dragging. Default true.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: Smallest drag (px) that counts as a selection. Default 6.

props.name: resetButton
props.doc: A "Reset zoom" chip while zoomed by the marquee. Default true.

props.name: onMarquee
props.doc: Called on every change (start, move, release, clear).

props.name: onMarqueeEnd
props.doc: Called when a drag finishes, with the selection (null when cleared).

props.name: zoomOnRelease
props.doc: @deprecated use `action: 'zoom'`.

props.name: x
props.doc: Vertical line. Default true.

props.name: y
props.doc: Horizontal line. Default true.

props.name: badges
props.doc: Value badges on the axes. Default true.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Snap the vertical line to the nearest category / data point. Default true.

props.name: value
props.doc: Which value to show next to the label ('series' / 'none' show the series name only).

props.name: exclude
props.doc: Series ids to skip.

props.name: markIndices
props.doc: Only label series of these `ChartOptions.series` entries.

props.name: position
props.doc: At the end (default) or the start of each line.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Text before the value.

props.name: showName
props.doc: Show the series name before the value. Default true.

props.name: directLabels
props.doc: Labels at the end of each line / area series, stacked to avoid overlaps.

props.name: color
props.doc: Data key to split series by color, or a static color `{ value: '#f00' }`. Default: one static color.

props.name: colorOverride
props.doc: Field holding a CSS color per row.

props.name: paddingRatio
props.doc: Gap between categories as a share of each category's slot. Default 0.4.

props.name: paddingOuter
props.doc: Space before the first and after the last category, as a share of a slot.

props.name: groupedPadding
props.doc: Gap between dodged bars as a share of their slot. Default `paddingRatio`.

props.name: lineWidth
props.doc: Border width in px (drawn in the bar's color).

props.name: dimensionDataType
props.doc: 'time' formats numeric categories as dates.

props.name: order
props.doc: Data key that orders the segments of a stack.

props.name: metricAxis
props.doc: Name of the `Axis` the values are drawn against (secondary metric axis).

props.name: dualMetricAxis
props.doc: Draws the last series against a second metric axis on the right.

props.name: showValues
props.doc: Shows the value next to each bar.

props.name: color
props.doc: Data key to split series by color, or a static color. Default: one static color.

props.name: staticPoint
props.doc: `true` marks every point; a data key marks the rows where it is truthy.

props.name: pointSize
props.doc: Marker size: a token ('S', 'M', …) or an area in px² (as in the legacy library, default 125).

props.name: isSparkline
props.doc: Sparkline styling (thin line, no hover dot).

props.name: isMethodLast
props.doc: With `isSparkline`: a point on the last value.

props.name: alternateSegmentKey
props.doc: Field marking rows drawn with the alternate (dotted) pattern.

props.name: alternateSegmentLineType
props.doc: Dash pattern of the alternate segments. Default 'dotted'.

props.name: metricAxis
props.doc: Name of the `Axis` the values are drawn against (secondary metric axis).

props.name: dualMetricAxis
props.doc: Draws the last series against a second metric axis on the right.

props.name: stroke
props.doc: Outline color of the points.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Radians.

interfaces.name: AxisLabel
interfaces.doc: An explicit tick: its value, optionally with its own text, alignment and weight.

interfaces.name: AxisSubLabel
interfaces.doc: A second label line under the tick with the same value.

props.name: title
props.doc: Axis title; an array draws one line per entry.

props.name: baseline
props.doc: Draws the axis line (off by default, as in the legacy library).

props.name: numberFormat
props.doc: Default 'shortNumber'.

props.name: currencyCode
props.doc: Currency for the currency number formats, e.g. 'EUR'.

props.name: currencyLocale
props.doc: Locale used to place the currency symbol, e.g. 'de-DE'.

props.name: truncateLabels
props.doc: Truncates category labels to the width of their band.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Only these ticks, with optional text and styling.

props.name: tickCountLimit
props.doc: Upper limit on the number of ticks.

props.name: tickCountMinimum
props.doc: Lower limit on the number of ticks.

props.name: tickMinStep
props.doc: Smallest step between two ticks (numeric axes), e.g. 1 for whole numbers.

props.name: hasTooltip
props.doc: Shows the full text of a (truncated) label on hover.

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Called when a tick label is clicked.

props.name: zoom
props.doc: Enables wheel / drag zoom (continuous axes).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Multi-level category labels (see also `AxisGroup`).

interfaces.name: AxisAnnotationProps
interfaces.doc: Event markers / spans in a lane along the parent `Axis`.

props.name: annotations
props.doc: Explicit annotations.

props.name: dataKey
props.doc: Data key holding annotation text. Each row with a value becomes a marker at the row's dimension value.

props.name: dimension
props.doc: Data key of the position (defaults to the chart's dimension).

props.name: format
props.doc: 'span' draws every annotation; 'summary' shows one badge with a count.

interfaces.name: AxisThumbnailProps
interfaces.doc: Images next to the ticks of the parent `Axis`.

props.name: urlKey
props.doc: Data key holding an image URL per category. Default 'thumbnail'.

props.name: dimension
props.doc: Data key of the category (defaults to the chart's dimension).

interfaces.name: AxisGroupProps
interfaces.doc: One level of grouped category labels on the parent `Axis`.

props.name: dataKey
props.doc: Data key holding the group of each category.

props.name: dimension
props.doc: Data key of the category (defaults to the chart's dimension).

interfaces.name: LinePointAnnotationProps
interfaces.doc: A labelled callout on a point of the parent `Line` (or `Bar` / `Area`).

props.name: dimensionValue
props.doc: Dimension value to annotate, or 'first' / 'last' / 'max' / 'min'. When omitted, every static point of the parent line (`staticPoint`) is labelled.

props.name: series
props.doc: Color facet value when the mark is split into several series.

props.name: textKey
props.doc: Data key shown as the label (default: the metric value).

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Side of the point; a list is tried in order.

props.name: matchLineColor
props.doc: Badge in the line's color (default) or plain text.

interfaces.name: ScatterAnnotationProps
interfaces.doc: Labels next to points of the parent `Scatter`.

props.name: textKey
props.doc: Data key shown as the label. Default: the metric.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Side of the point; a list is tried in order until a label fits.

props.name: position
props.doc: Alias of `anchor`.

interfaces.name: ScatterPathProps
interfaces.doc: Lines connecting points of the parent `Scatter`.

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Data key(s) that split points into separate paths.

props.name: color
props.doc: Default 'gray-500'.

props.name: opacity
props.doc: Default 0.5.

interfaces.name: AnnotationProps
interfaces.doc: A value badge on each bar of the parent `Bar`.

props.name: textKey
props.doc: Data key shown in the badge. Default: the metric.

interfaces.name: BarDirectLabelProps
interfaces.doc: Value labels on the bars of the parent `Bar`.

props.name: dataKey
props.doc: Data key shown instead of the metric.

props.name: overflow
